model.name: ONE canonical sprint-dir resolver (sprintDirOf) - every consumer + the guard route through it; slug-only emission stops
model.description: There are TWO conventions for one sprint directory: CANONICAL (tracked, git history, everything references it) scrum.pmo/sprints/sprint-0N-<slug>/, and STRAY (generated, untracked, 16 of them) scrum.pmo/sprints/<slug>/ slug-only. The stray path comes from consumers using the Sprint unit model.slug (or slugify(name)) as the dir (server.ts:1416 taskMdHref; check-sprint-slug-dir.ts - the GUARD itself resolves the slug-only path, so the guard BLESSES the stray convention). A regen then materialises sprints/<slug>/. FIX by construction: ONE exported sprintDirOf(sprint) -> sprint-0N-<slug> that EVERY consumer (including the guard) routes through; slug-only emission STOPS; a sprint dir built without sprintDirOf => lint RED.

discoverySource.foundBy: robbin-req (R40.51 orphan verify: 16 untracked slug-only generator dirs)

model.crossRefNote: Same design as R40.48 (193265837, two by-construction guards). Same ONE-source pattern as R40.50 (one comparator). R40.4 = sprint naming family. Surfaced by my R40.51 Finding-2 (16 untracked slug-only sprint dirs = generator output duplicating the tracked sprint-0N- dirs).

acceptanceCriteria.text: ONE exported sprintDirOf(sprintUnit) -> sprint-0N-<slug> (zero-padded number + slug, derived from sprintNumOf), living next to sprintNumOf/bySprintDisplayOrder in the sprint-pin-resolver/sprint-label home. It is the SINGLE source for which directory is this sprint.

EVERY consumer routes through sprintDirOf: the MD generator(s), server.ts:1416 taskMdHref, AND - critically - check-sprint-slug-dir.ts (the GUARD must verify the CANONICAL sprint-0N-<slug>/ exists, not the slug-only path). Today the guard resolves the slug-only path = it BLESSES the disease; routing it through sprintDirOf fixes the complicit guard.
No consumer builds sprints/<model.slug>/ anymore -> slug-only emission STOPS. The canonical dir is the ONLY dir any consumer produces.

A consumer that builds a sprint dir path WITHOUT sprintDirOf (e.g. raw sprints/${model.slug}) => grep-lint RED. Invariant-gate (assert the shared resolver is used), NOT a value-gate (do not merely check one path renders right) - the same lesson as R40.50 AC-invariant-gate.

Nobody commits the 16 stray sprints/<slug>/ dirs (they are the duplicate). Once sprintDirOf lands + regen re-emits to the canonical dir, the strays are deleted in their OWN commit. (Architect/expert owns the generator fix + the deletion; this req captures the invariant.)
